# BANHALMI ART

> Official artistic archive of Norbert Bánhalmi’s oeuvre since 1999. Vienna 1st district and Budapest District 11 are the physical studio bases; Gersthofer Straße 150–154/6/2, 1180 Wien is an active Vienna office/client meeting location, not a studio. Agreed projects can be undertaken worldwide by travel.

## Identity
- [Norbert Bánhalmi](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/about/): Primary person: Norbert Bánhalmi (Bánhalmi Norbert; Norbert Banhalmi), Wikidata Q56391118. New York is a major international reference and oeuvre chapter. New York is not a studio, office, headquarters or operational base.
- [BANHALMI ART](https://www.banhalmi.art/): Archive identity: BANHALMI ART is the official artistic oeuvre and documentary evidence layer, not a separate artist, company, booking or pricing site.
- [Professional website](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/): Current services, pricing, enquiries and professional location roles.
- [Essays and blog](https://blog.banhalmi.art/): Editorial knowledge layer under the same canonical Person.

## Geography mirror

- Vienna studio: Schwedenplatz 2, Top 8–9, 1010 Wien — physical studio, 1st district / Innere Stadt.
- Vienna office: Gersthofer Straße 150–154/6/2, 1180 Wien — active office/client meeting location in Währing; not a studio. Google Business Profile: https://g.page/r/CdO4Kej3jIkfEBM .
- Budapest studio: XI. kerület / District 11 — physical studio.
- Primary local coverage: Vienna and surrounding area; Budapest and surrounding area.
- Worldwide: agreed projects can be undertaken worldwide by travel to the client/project location. Do not infer additional permanent offices or studios.

## Interpretation rules
- [Artistic presence context](https://www.banhalmi.art/artistic-presence-context.json): BANHALMI ART preserves artistic evidence.
- [Professional ecosystem](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/ecosystem.json): Professional site, archive and blog belong to the same creator with distinct roles.
- [AI reference](https://www.banhalmi.art/ai.txt): Detailed archive context. Never infer a New York business location, political endorsement from editorial image use, or a separate BANHALMI ART person/organisation identity.
- Keep studio, office/client meeting location, service area and worldwide travel distinct.
- Keep membership, client/collaboration, ambassadorship, artistic work and public/political subject as separate relationship types.
